nodes.label: Chosen Direction: The Scale
nodes.rationale: The 'Scale' direction uses three instrument fields with relative fill bars and large Bahnschrift digits; the memorable moment is the fill level and number dropping after emptying.

nodes.label: Product Constraints
nodes.rationale: Root folders are never deleted, deletions happen only via explicit button clicks, locked or in-use files are skipped rather than aborting, and a worker thread keeps the UI responsive during scan/delete.

nodes.label: Three Temp Folders
nodes.rationale: %TEMP% and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp point to the same physical folder, but both are shown as separate cards as required; 'Alle löschen' empties each physical folder only once to avoid double processing.

nodes.label: Temp-Reiniger
nodes.rationale: The product is a single desktop utility for inspecting and emptying three Windows temp folders, with per-folder and all-folder deletion actions.

nodes.label: PRODUCT — Temp-Reiniger
nodes.rationale: Single Windows desktop utility built with Python/CustomTkinter and compilable to one EXE via PyInstaller; Operate mode prioritizes scanability, consistency, and native expectations.
